rules.title: Cache Components with 'use cache' are mandatory in Next.js 17
rules.description: In Next.js 17, Cache Components powered by Partial Prerendering and the 'use cache' directive are the default and mandatory caching architecture. Legacy implicit fetch caching and options like { cache: 'force-cache' } are removed.

remediation.summary: Wrap data-fetching functions in 'use cache' directive instead of using legacy fetch cache parameters.

rules.title: Pages router imports from 'next/router' are deprecated in Next.js 17
rules.description: The legacy Pages router has reached maintenance mode in Next.js 17. Importing useRouter from 'next/router' is deprecated in favor of 'next/navigation' in the App Router.

remediation.summary: Migrate Pages router routes to App Router and import useRouter from 'next/navigation'.

rules.title: next/head component removed in Next.js 17
rules.description: The next/head component from the Pages router is completely removed in Next.js 17. Use the Metadata API in layout.tsx or page.tsx.

remediation.summary: Replace next/head with exported metadata object or generateMetadata function in App Router.

rules.title: Webpack configuration fallback removed; Turbopack strictly enforced in Next.js 17
rules.description: Next.js 17 removes the legacy webpack engine entirely. Any custom webpack configuration in next.config.js that does not have Turbopack loader rules will cause compilation failure.

remediation.summary: Remove webpack configuration block from next.config.js and migrate custom loaders to Turbopack rules.

rules.title: Synchronous dynamic request APIs (cookies, headers) fail at compile-time in Next.js 17
rules.description: Calling cookies() or headers() synchronously without await throws a compile-time build error in Next.js 17. All dynamic request APIs must be awaited.

remediation.summary: Convert synchronous cookies() and headers() calls to async/await.
